versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ghapp: Authenticate as a GitHub App for all git and gh operations.
- Supports multiple profiles, enabling distinct identities for different GitHub Apps or clients.
- Interactive setup wizard and commands for managing authentication, configuration, and tokens.
- Integrates with both git and gh, allowing seamless commit attribution to GitHub App bot accounts.
- Offers several authentication modes for diverse use cases (shell integration, CI, static token).
- Provides local token caching, per-profile config, and easy profile switching.
